WITH per_member AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_total
  FROM income
  WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_total) AS total_income
  FROM per_member
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT member_total * 1.0 / total_income AS ratio
  FROM per_member
  CROSS JOIN overall
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM ratios
),
selected AS (
  SELECT p.member_total, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM per_member AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a
  JOIN ratios AS r ON r.ratio = p.member_total * 1.0 / o.total_income
  WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio
)
SELECT SUM(member_total), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference)
FROM selected
